answer_1.quote: We explore both generative and retrieval models that handle multimodal dialogue ... We test our final models using human evaluation ... The overall win rate against humans ...

answer_2.quote: We measure recall at 1 and 5 (R@1/100 and R@5/100) retrieval metrics ... For the generative models we report the ROUGE-L metric ... We measure our best TRANSRESNET GEN model's performance on the IGC test set in terms of BLEU-4.

answer_4.quote: We use a set of human evaluators look at the provided conversation turns, and ask them to compare two possible utterances ... We ask the evaluators in a blind test to choose the "more engaging" of the two possible utterances.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators compare a model-generated utterance with a human-authored utterance and select the one that is more engaging.
